title.en: Intensive reading: The meaning of security

intro.en: A reading passage about security (al-amn), one of Allah's great blessings. It explains how Islam protects life, wealth and society.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum amn (security) ke baare mein ek paragraph parhenge. Yeh Allah ki bari nemat hai. Islam jaan, maal aur muashre ki hifazat kaise karta hai, yeh samjhenge.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الأَمْنِ، وَهُوَ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ نِعَمِ اللهِ. يُبَيِّنُ كَيْفَ يَحْفَظُ الإِسْلامُ النَّفْسَ وَالمالَ وَالمُجْتَمَعَ.

dialogue.ar: الأَمْنُ في الدُّنْيا نِعْمَةٌ مِنَ النِّعَمِ الكُبْرى.
dialogue.tr: al-amnu fid-dunyā niʿmatun mina n-niʿami l-kubrā
dialogue.en: Security in this world is one of the greatest blessings.
dialogue.ur: Duniya mein amn bari nematon mein se ek nemat hai.

dialogue.ar: فَهُوَ سَبيلٌ لِلراحَةِ وَالطُّمَأْنينَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fahuwa sabīlun lir-rāḥati waṭ-ṭumaʾnīna
dialogue.en: It is a path to comfort and calm.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sukoon aur itminan ka raasta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَعَدَ اللهُ المُؤْمِنينَ أَنْ يُوَفِّرَ لَهُمُ الأَمْنَ مِنْ بَعْدِ الخَوْفِ.
dialogue.tr: waʿada llāhu l-muʾminīna an yuwaffira lahumu l-amna min baʿdi l-khawf
dialogue.en: Allah promised the believers to give them security after fear.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne momino se wada kiya ke khof ke baad unhein amn dega.

dialogue.ar: الأَمْنُ سَبَبُ السَّعادَةِ وَالاسْتِقْرارِ.
dialogue.tr: al-amnu sababu s-saʿādati wal-istiqrār
dialogue.en: Security is a cause of happiness and stability.
dialogue.ur: Amn khushi aur istiqraar ka sabab hai.

dialogue.ar: حَرَّمَ اللهُ سُبْحانَهُ وَتَعالى نَفْسَ المُؤْمِنِ عَلى غَيْرِهِ مِنَ البَشَرِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥarrama llāhu nafsa l-muʾmini ʿalā ghayrihi mina l-bashar
dialogue.en: Allah made a believer's life forbidden to other people to harm.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne momin ki jaan ko doosre insanon par haraam kiya.

dialogue.ar: فَلا يَجوزُ الاعْتِداءُ عَلَيْها وَقَتْلُها أَوْ إيذاؤُها.
dialogue.tr: falā yajūzu l-iʿtidāʾu ʿalayhā wa qatluhā aw īdhāʾuhā
dialogue.en: So it is not allowed to attack it, kill it or hurt it.
dialogue.ur: Is liye us par zulm karna, qatl karna ya takleef dena jaiz nahin.

dialogue.ar: النَّفْسُ البَشَرِيَّةُ لَها دَوافِعُ لِلخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ.
dialogue.tr: an-nafsu l-basharīyatu lahā dawāfiʿu lil-khayri wash-sharr
dialogue.en: The human soul has motives toward good and evil.
dialogue.ur: Insani nafs mein neki aur burai dono ki taraf mayl hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِسْلامُ لَمْ يَتْرُكْ صَغيرَةً وَلا كَبيرَةً مِنْ سُلوكِ العِبادِ إِلاّ وَضَعَ لَها قَواعِدَ.
dialogue.tr: wal-islāmu lam yatruk ṣaghīratan wa lā kabīratan min sulūki l-ʿibādi illā waḍaʿa lahā qawāʿid
dialogue.en: Islam left no small or big matter of people's behaviour without setting rules for it.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne bandon ke rawaiye ki koi chhoti ya badi baat nahin chhori jis ke liye usool na rakhe hon.

dialogue.ar: قَرَّرَ الخالِقُ لِكُلِّ عَمَلٍ مُخِلٍّ بِأَمْنِ الفَرْدِ وَالجَماعَةِ عُقوبَةً رادِعَةً.
dialogue.tr: qarrara l-khāliqu likulli ʿamalin mukhillin biʾamni l-fardi wal-jamāʿati ʿuqūbatan rādiʿah
dialogue.en: The Creator set a deterring punishment for every act that harms the security of the individual and the community.
dialogue.ur: Khaliq ne har us amal ke liye jo fard aur jamaat ke amn ko bigaade, rokne wali saza muqarrar ki.

q.en: According to the passage, what is security?
q.ur: Passage ke mutabiq amn kya hai?

q.en: What is the cause of happiness and stability?
q.ur: Khushi aur istiqraar ka sabab kya hai?

q.en: What does the human soul incline toward?
q.ur: Insani nafs kis ki taraf mayl karta hai?
q.ar: إِلى أَيِّ شَيْءٍ تَميلُ النَّفْسُ الإِنْسانِيَّةُ؟

options_ar: لا إِلى هذا وَلا إِلى ذاكَ

q.en: What did the Creator set for every act that harms security?
q.ur: Amn bigaadne wale har amal ke liye Khaliq ne kya muqarrar kiya?
q.ar: ماذا وَضَعَ الخالِقُ لِكُلِّ فِعْلٍ يُخِلُّ بِالأَمْنِ؟

title.ar: القَواعِدُ (أ): الجُمَلُ التي لَها مَحَلٌّ مِنَ الإِعْراب
title.en: Grammar A: Sentences that have a grammatical position
title.ur: Qawaid (alif): Wo jumle jin ka i'rab mein maqam hota hai

intro.en: Sometimes a whole sentence works like a single word. For example, in 'I passed by a girl her manners are high', the sentence 'her manners are high' describes the girl, so it is a description (sifa). Here we practise sentences that act as a description (sifa) or as a state (hal).
intro.ur: Kabhi poora jumla ek lafz ki tarah kaam karta hai. Misal: 'mein ek ladki ke paas se guzra, us ke akhlaaq buland hain' — yahan 'us ke akhlaaq buland hain' ladki ki sifat bayan karta hai. Is sabaq mein hum sifa aur haal wale jumle seekhenge.
intro.ar: أَحْياناً تَقومُ جُمْلَةٌ كامِلَةٌ مَقامَ كَلِمَةٍ واحِدَةٍ، مِثْلَ: مَرَرْتُ بِفَتاةٍ أَخْلاقُها عالِيَةٌ؛ فَجُمْلَةُ «أَخْلاقُها عالِيَةٌ» تَصِفُ الفَتاةَ، فَهِيَ في مَحَلِّ صِفَةٍ. نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى الجُمَلِ الَّتي تَكونُ صِفَةً أَوْ حالاً.

dialogue.ar: البِنْتُ أَخْلاقُها عالِيَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-bintu akhlāquhā ʿāliya
dialogue.en: The girl, her manners are high.
dialogue.ur: Ladki, us ke akhlaaq buland hain.

dialogue.ar: ما زالَتِ البِنْتُ أَخْلاقُها عالِيَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: mā zālati l-bintu akhlāquhā ʿāliya
dialogue.en: The girl is still of high manners.
dialogue.ur: Ladki ab bhi buland akhlaaq wali hai.

dialogue.ar: مَرَرْتُ بِبِنْتٍ أَخْلاقُها عالِيَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: marartu bibintin akhlāquhā ʿāliya
dialogue.en: I passed by a girl whose manners are high.
dialogue.ur: Mein ek aisi ladki ke paas se guzra jis ke akhlaaq buland hain.

dialogue.ar: خُطُّهُ جَميلٌ.
dialogue.tr: khaṭṭuhu jamīl
dialogue.en: His handwriting is beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Us ki likhai khoobsurat hai.

q.en: After an indefinite noun, a sentence works as what?
q.ur: Nakira ke baad aane wala jumla kya hota hai?
q.ar: الجُمْلَةُ بَعْدَ اسْمٍ نَكِرَةٍ تَكونُ في مَحَلِّ:

q.en: After a definite noun, a sentence usually works as what?
q.ur: Ma'rifa ke baad aane wala jumla aam tor par kya hota hai?
q.ar: الجُمْلَةُ بَعْدَ اسْمٍ مَعْرِفَةٍ تَكونُ غالِباً في مَحَلِّ:

q.en: In 'I passed by a girl whose manners are high', what does 'her manners are high' do?
q.ur: 'Mein ek ladki se guzra jis ke akhlaaq buland hain' mein 'akhlaaq buland hain' kya kaam karta hai?
q.ar: في «مَرَرْتُ بِفَتاةٍ أَخْلاقُها عالِيَةٌ» ماذا تَفْعَلُ جُمْلَةُ «أَخْلاقُها عالِيَةٌ»؟

q.en: What does 'مَحَلٌّ مِنَ الإِعْراب' mean?
q.ur: 'مَحَلٌّ مِنَ الإِعْراب' ka kya matlab hai?

title.ar: فَهْمُ المَسْموع: هَلْ أَسْئِلَةُ طِفْلِكَ تُقْلِقُك؟
title.en: Listening: Do your child's questions worry you?
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Kya aap ke bachche ke sawalat aap ko pareshan karte hain?

intro.en: Two listening parts about children's questions. Listen, then mark each sentence true or false. Children ask many questions because they are curious; parents should answer wisely, and ignoring questions has bad effects.
intro.ur: Yeh bachchon ke sawalat ke baare mein do sunne ke hisse hain. Sun kar har jumle ko sahih ya ghalat batana hai. Bachche isliye sawal poochte hain ke woh jaanna chahte hain; walidain ko samajhdari se jawab dena chahiye.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الطِّفْلِ. اسْتَمِعْ ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ. يَسْأَلُ الأَطْفالُ كَثيراً لِأَنَّهُمْ فُضولِيُّونَ، وَعَلى الوالِدَيْنِ أَنْ يُجيبا بِحِكْمَةٍ، وَتَجاهُلُ الأَسْئِلَةِ لَهُ آثارٌ سَيِّئَةٌ.

q.en: Using questions helps develop what in a child?
q.ur: Sawal karna bachche mein kya barhata hai?

q.en: What do children's questions reveal?
q.ur: Bachchon ke sawal kis cheez ko zahir karte hain?

q.en: How does a child feel if his questions are ignored?
q.ur: Agar sawalon ko nazar-andaz kiya jaye to bachcha kya mehsoos karta hai?
q.ar: بِماذا يَشْعُرُ الطِّفْلُ إِذا أُهْمِلَتْ أَسْئِلَتُهُ؟

q.en: A child asking many questions is a sign of what?
q.ur: Bachche ka bohat sawal karna kis ki nishani hai?

title.ur: Behtar izhaar: Sher parhna aur sunana

intro.en: How to recite poetry well: reading aloud with melody and clear pronunciation. A good delivery depends on correct language, good pronunciation, and expressing feelings such as joy or sadness. Then read a poem by Hafiz Ibrahim about the Arabic language.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein seekhenge ke sher kaise achhe se parha jata hai: buland awaaz, sahih alfaaz aur jazbaat ke saath. Phir Hafiz Ibrahim ka Arabi zuban ke baare mein qaseeda parhenge.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى إِنْشادِ الشِّعْرِ: القِراءَةُ بِصَوْتٍ عالٍ مَعَ نَغَمٍ وَنُطْقٍ واضِحٍ. يَعْتَمِدُ الإِلْقاءُ الجَيِّدُ عَلى سَلامَةِ اللُّغَةِ وَحُسْنِ النُّطْقِ وَالتَّعْبيرِ عَنِ المَشاعِرِ كَالفَرَحِ وَالحُزْنِ. ثُمَّ نَقْرَأُ قَصيدَةً لِحافِظ إِبْراهيمَ عَنِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.

q.en: What does a good recitation of poetry include?
q.ur: Achhe sher parhne mein kya shamil hota hai?

q.en: Poetry is recited with what kind of voice?
q.ur: Sher kis qism ki awaaz mein parha jata hai?

q.en: Which feelings should the reciter express?
q.ur: Sher parhne wala kin jazbaat ka izhaar kare?
q.ar: أَيَّ المَشاعِرِ يَنْبَغي أَنْ يُظْهِرَ المُنْشِدُ؟

options: Joy, sadness and wonder as the meaning needs

q.en: The poem in the exercise is by whom?
q.ur: Mashq mein diya gaya qaseeda kis ka hai?

title.ar: القَواعِدُ (ب): الجُمَلُ التي لا مَحَلَّ لَها مِنَ الإِعْراب
title.en: Grammar B: Sentences with no grammatical position
title.ur: Qawaid (be): Wo jumle jin ka i'rab mein koi maqam nahin

intro.en: Some sentences do not take the place of a single word, so they have no grammatical position. Kinds include: opening sentences (ibtidaiyya), the clause after 'alladhi' (silat al-mawsul), interrupting sentences (mu'tarida), the answer of an oath, and the answer of a condition.
intro.ur: Kuch jumle kisi ek lafz ki jagah nahin lete, is liye un ka i'rab mein koi maqam nahin hota. Inki qismein: ibtidaiyya (shuru ka jumla), silat al-mawsul ('alladhi' ke baad ka jumla), mu'tarida (darmiyan mein aane wala), qasam ka jawab, aur shart ka jawab.
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الجُمَلِ لا تَحُلُّ مَحَلَّ كَلِمَةٍ واحِدَةٍ، فَلا مَحَلَّ لَها مِنَ الإِعْرابِ. مِنْ أَنْواعِها: الجُمْلَةُ الِابْتِدائِيَّةُ، وَصِلَةُ المَوْصولِ بَعْدَ «الَّذي»، وَالجُمْلَةُ الِاعْتِراضِيَّةُ، وَجَوابُ القَسَمِ، وَجَوابُ الشَّرْطِ.

dialogue.ar: الَّذي يَدْعو إِلى التَّعاوُنِ عَلى البِرِّ وَالتَّقْوى يَسْتَحِقُّ التَّكْريمَ.
dialogue.tr: alladhī yadʿū ilā t-taʿāwuni ʿalā l-birri wat-taqwā yastaḥiqqu t-takrīm
dialogue.en: Whoever calls to cooperation in goodness and piety deserves honour.
dialogue.ur: Jo neki aur taqwa mein ta'awun ki dawat deta hai woh izzat ka mustahiq hai.

dialogue.ar: إِذا اجْتَهَدْتَ نَجَحْتَ يا وَلَدي.
dialogue.tr: idhā ijtahadta najaḥta yā waladī
dialogue.en: If you work hard, you will succeed, my son.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum mehnat karoge to kamyab hoge, mere bete.

dialogue.ar: اسْعَ – رَعاكَ اللهُ – إِلى فِعْلِ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تَجِدْ جَزاءَهُ.
dialogue.tr: isʿa – raʿāka llāhu – ilā fiʿli kulli khayrin tajid jazāʾah
dialogue.en: Strive, may Allah protect you, to do every good and you will find its reward.
dialogue.ur: Koshish karo, Allah teri hifazat kare, har neki karne ki, to tum us ka badla paoge.

q.en: What does 'ibtidaiyya' mean?
q.ur: 'Ibtidaiyya' ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: The relative clause after 'alladhi' has what position?
q.ur: 'Alladhi' ke baad ke jumle ka kya maqam hai?
q.ar: ما مَوْقِعُ صِلَةِ المَوْصولِ بَعْدَ «الَّذي» مِنَ الإِعْرابِ؟

q.en: In 'If you work hard, you succeed', what is 'you succeed'?
q.ur: 'Agar mehnat karo to kamyab ho' mein 'kamyab ho' kya hai?
q.ar: في «إِنْ تَجْتَهِدْ تَنْجَحْ» ما إِعْرابُ جُمْلَةِ «تَنْجَحْ»؟

options: The answer of a non-jussive condition

q.en: What is a 'mu'tarida' sentence?
q.ur: 'Mu'tarida' jumla kya hota hai?

options: A sentence that interrupts in the middle

intro.en: A family story. Amina invites her family for dinner and says a prize of a million dinars is coming to her. Each person dreams of what they would do with it. In the end it is only a joke, and Amina learns something about her family. After reading, answer the questions.
intro.ur: Ek ghar ki kahani. Amina apne ghar walon ko khane par bulati hai aur kehti hai ke use milyon dinar ka inaam milne wala hai. Har ek apne khayalon mein sochta hai ke woh is ka kya karega. Aakhir mein yeh sirf mazaaq nikalta hai. Parh kar sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عائِلِيَّةٌ: تَدْعو آمِنَةُ أَهْلَها إِلى العَشاءِ وَتَقولُ إِنَّ جائِزَةً بِمِلْيونِ دينارٍ سَتَصِلُها. يَحْلُمُ كُلُّ واحِدٍ بِما سَيَفْعَلُ بِها. وَفي النِّهايَةِ يَتَبَيَّنُ أَنَّها مُزْحَةٌ، وَتَتَعَلَّمُ آمِنَةُ شَيْئاً عَنْ أَهْلِها. بَعْدَ القِراءَةِ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

dialogue.ar: لَحَظاتٌ رائِعَةٌ تُمْطِرُ سَعادَةً وَحُبّاً.
dialogue.tr: laḥaẓātun rāʾiʿatun tumṭiru saʿādatan wa ḥubbā
dialogue.en: Wonderful moments raining happiness and love.
dialogue.ur: Shandaar lamhe jo khushi aur mohabbat barsate hain.

dialogue.ar: هَيّا يا صَغيري! هَيّا كُلْ هَذِهِ المُلوخِيَّةِ، طَبَخْتُها خَصّيصاً لِأَجْلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: hayyā yā ṣaghīrī! hayyā kul hādhihi l-mulūkhiyya, ṭabakhtuhā khaṣṣīṣan li-ajlik
dialogue.en: Come on, my little one! Eat this mulukhiyya, I cooked it just for you.
dialogue.ur: Chalo mere chhote! Yeh mulukhiyya khao, mein ne khaas tumhare liye pakai hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالآنَ أَيْنَ المُفاجَأَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: wal-āna ayna l-mufājaʾa
dialogue.en: And now, where is the surprise?
dialogue.ur: Aur ab surprise kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: أَنا مَشْغولَةٌ مُنْذُ شَهْرٍ بِحَلِّ مُسابَقاتٍ وَأَلْغازٍ، جائِزَتُها مِلْيونُ دينارٍ.
dialogue.tr: anā mashghūlatun mundhu shahrin biḥalli musābaqātin wa alghāz, jāʾizatuhā milyūnu dīnār
dialogue.en: For a month I have been busy solving contests and puzzles, whose prize is a million dinars.
dialogue.ur: Mein ek mahine se muqablon aur paheliyon ko hal karne mein masroof hoon, jis ka inaam milyon dinar hai.

dialogue.ar: مِلْيونُ دينارٍ؟ غَيْرُ مَعْقولٍ!
dialogue.tr: milyūnu dīnār? ghayru maʿqūl
dialogue.en: A million dinars? Unbelievable!
dialogue.ur: Milyon dinar? Namumkin!

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ سَتَفوزينَ بِالمِلْيونِ دينارٍ حَتْماً!
dialogue.tr: idhan satafūzīna bil-milyūni dīnārin ḥatmā
dialogue.en: Then you will surely win the million dinars!
dialogue.ur: To tum zaroor milyon dinar jeet logi!

dialogue.ar: لَنْ يَكونَ لي وَحْدي. إِذا حَصَلَ وَكُنْتُ الفائِزَةَ لَتَقاسَمْتُهُ بِالتَّساوي مَعَكُمْ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: lan yakūna lī waḥdī. idhā ḥaṣala wa kuntu l-fāʾiza lataqāsamtuhu bit-tasāwī maʿakum jamīʿā
dialogue.en: It will not be mine alone. If I win, I will share it equally with all of you.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sirf mere liye nahin hoga. Agar mein jeeti to barabar sab ke saath baantungi.

dialogue.ar: لَنْ أُفْشِيَ سِرَّكُمْ. لا تَخافوا، عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُجيبوا بِصِدْقٍ وَصَراحَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: lan ufshiya sirrakum. lā takhāfū, ʿalaykum an tujībū biṣidqin wa ṣarāḥa
dialogue.en: I will not reveal your secret. Do not be afraid, answer truthfully and openly.
dialogue.ur: Mein aap ka raaz faash nahin karoongi. Daro nahin, sach aur saaf goi se jawab dein.

dialogue.ar: شَعَرَتْ بِدُوارٍ خَفيفٍ.
dialogue.tr: shaʿarat biduwārin khafīf
dialogue.en: She felt a slight dizziness.
dialogue.ur: Use halka sa chakkar aaya.

dialogue.ar: حَمَلَتْ كُلَّ الإِجاباتِ الَّتي تَعِبَتْ فيها شَهْراً كامِلاً وَأَلْقَتْ بِذَلِكَ الحِمْلَ الثَّقيلَ في سَلَّةِ المُهْمَلاتِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥamalat kulla l-ijābāti llatī taʿibat fīhā shahran kāmilan wa alqat bidhālika l-ḥimla th-thaqīla fī sallati l-muhmalāt
dialogue.en: She carried all the answers she had worked on for a whole month and threw that heavy load into the waste basket.
dialogue.ur: Us ne woh sab jawab uthaye jin mein ek poora mahina mehnat ki thi aur woh bhari bojh kachre ki tokri mein phenk diya.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ هِيَ المُفاجَأَةُ الَّتي أَعْدَدْتُها لَكُمْ. كانَتْ قِصَّةُ المِلْيونِ مُزاحاً!
dialogue.tr: hādhihi hiya l-mufājaʾatu llatī aʿdadtuhā lakum. kānat qiṣṣatu l-milyūni muzāḥā
dialogue.en: This is the surprise I prepared for you. The million story was a joke!
dialogue.ur: Yeh woh surprise hai jo mein ne aap ke liye tayyar kiya. Milyon ki kahani mazaaq thi!

dialogue.ar: نَحْنُ في أَشَدِّ الحاجَةِ إِلى الحَلْوى لِنَمْسَحَ بِها مَرارَةَ أَفْواهِنا.
dialogue.tr: naḥnu fī ashaddi l-ḥājati ilā l-ḥalwā linamsaḥa bihā marārata afwāhinā
dialogue.en: We badly need the sweets to wipe the bitterness from our mouths.
dialogue.ur: Hamein meethe ki sakht zaroorat hai taake us se munh ki kadwahat door karein.

q.en: What did Amina claim she had won?
q.ur: Amina ne kya jeetne ka dawa kiya?

options: A prize of a million dinars

q.en: What did Amina say she would do with the prize if she won?
q.ur: Amina ne kaha ke inaam jeet kar woh kya karegi?
q.ar: ماذا قالَتْ آمِنَةُ إِنَّها سَتَفْعَلُ بِالجائِزَةِ لَوْ رَبِحَتْ؟

q.en: What was the truth about the million?
q.ur: Milyon ki haqeeqat kya thi?

options: It was a lie by a neighbour

q.en: What did Amina do with her answer papers?
q.ur: Amina ne apne jawabi kaghaz ka kya kiya?

options: Threw them away and burned them

q.en: What did she serve at the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein us ne kya pesh kiya?

intro.en: Words and expressions from the story, with exercises: fill in the verbs, put in words from the root ج-م-ع (j-m-ʿ) such as جَمْع (gathering) and جامِعَة (university), and understand idioms.
intro.ur: Kahani ke alfaaz aur muhawarat, mashqon ke saath: khaali jagah par sahih fe'l likhna, aur jeem-meem-ayn (ج-م-ع) ke maadde se bane alfaaz jaise جَمْع aur جامِعَة, aur muhawarat ko samajhna.
intro.ar: كَلِماتٌ وَتَعْبيراتٌ مِنَ القِصَّةِ مَعَ تَمارينَ: نَمْلَأُ الفَراغاتِ بِأَفْعالٍ، وَنَسْتَعْمِلُ كَلِماتٍ مِنَ الجَذْرِ (ج م ع) مِثْلَ جَمْعٌ وَجامِعَةٌ، وَنَفْهَمُ تَعْبيراتٍ اصْطِلاحِيَّةً.

vocab.en: an idea came to his mind
vocab.ur: us ke zehn mein khayal aaya

q.en: What does 'تَقاسَمَ' mean?
q.ur: 'تَقاسَمَ' ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: What does 'سَلِمَتْ يَداكَ' express?
q.ur: 'سَلِمَتْ يَداكَ' kya zahir karta hai?

q.en: Which word comes from the root ج-م-ع and means 'university'?
q.ur: ج-م-ع ke maadde se kaun sa lafz 'university' hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ مِنَ الجَذْرِ (ج م ع) وَتَعْني مَكانَ الدِّراسَةِ الجامِعِيَّةِ؟

q.en: What does 'بَصيصُ أَمَلٍ' mean?
q.ur: 'بَصيصُ أَمَلٍ' ka kya matlab hai?
